A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same work, Large Action Models: From Inception to Implementation. All 25 pages, including figures, tables, equations and Appendices A–E, are readable and support a complete comparison.

before.justification: Sections 5 and 7 report original offline planning, Word action-prediction and online agent experiments, with numerical outcomes in Tables 2–4.

after.justification: The later version retains the original experiments and their numerical outcomes in Sections 5 and 7 and Tables 2–4.

M1.justification: The four-phase Mistral-7B training pipeline, reward model, offline PPO and UFO integration are unchanged. Figure 8's corrected section references do not alter the method.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same application-documentation, WikiHow, search-query and evolved task-plan data, alongside Word task-action data. Windows planning and Word agent evaluation coverage is unchanged.

E2.justification: Table 2 retains GPT-4o and Mistral-7B as planning comparators. Tables 3–4 retain GPT-4o and GPT-4o Mini, with identical text-only offline comparisons and text-only/text-plus-visual online comparisons.

E3.justification: Training settings, the 1,757/435 Word trajectory split, the 15,334-task planning evaluation, evaluation metrics and GPT-4o judging procedures are unchanged.

E4.justification: The training-phase comparisons in Table 3 and screenshot-input ablation for the GPT baselines in Table 4 are identical. No ablations, robustness tests or supplementary analyses are added or removed.

E5.justification: Both versions retain the same point-estimate reporting, without repeated-run or seed counts, confidence intervals, error bars or significance tests.

E6.justification: All entries in Tables 2–4 and the accompanying findings are unchanged. For example, the final LAM retains 81.2% offline task success in Table 3 and 71.0% online task success with 30.42-second completion time in Table 4.

T1.justification: The training-loss and reward/PPO formulations in Section 4 and the dataset, state and action definitions in Appendix E are identical. No mathematical reasoning or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contribution: a generalizable LAM development workflow illustrated through a Windows/UFO case study.

C2.justification: Interpretations of progressive training and accuracy–efficiency tradeoffs are unchanged. Section 8 retains the same safety, ethical, regulatory, scalability and generalization limitations.

D1.justification: Hyperparameters, hardware, implementation descriptions, code/documentation links and Appendix A–D templates and prompts are unchanged. No reproducibility information is added or removed.

R1.justification: Section 9 and the reference list are identical, with no changes to cited works or research positioning.

P1.justification: The first-page arXiv version/date stamp is updated, and Figure 8's textual section references are corrected. Narrative wording, section organization and appendix text remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 8 changes the references for phases 1–4 from Sections 4.2–4.5 to the correct Sections 4.1–4.4 and slightly repositions the lower Phase 4 Data Resource label. Other figures, tables and page layouts are unchanged.

improvement.justification: Correcting Figure 8's four erroneous section references makes the training overview accurately point to its detailed explanations. This provides a small improvement in navigability and editorial accuracy; the scientific content, empirical evidence and appendices are unchanged.
